evidence.title: DeepL AI Platform: Translation, Voice & API
DeepL Pro | Translate Text, Word Docs & Other Docs Securely

name: DeepL
summary: AI translation platform for text, documents, voice and media in 100+ languages, with a developer API.
description: Translation and writing tools: a web translator, document and file translation in 100+ languages, real-time voice translation, DeepL Write and an API that apps and AI assistants integrate. Free tier is limited to 50,000 characters per month; Pro plans serve individuals, teams and businesses.
contains: text, file, document and voice translation in 100+ languages
individual plan €7.49/month billed annually; team €24.99 per user/month
developer API and integrations with AI assistants and apps
glossaries, style rule lists and translation memory on paid plans
